area.description: Generation specifies level, the quoted area identifier and seed. Entry matches exactly ": You have entered ….". Tile/Doodad hashes are decimal numbers. Two diagnostic phrases are matched literally. Generation alone does not prove a map visit.

instance.description: Login server details and decimal Client-Safe Instance ID are separate messages. Analytics establishes their relationship to a visit.

loading.description: An area name in parentheses and Duration in seconds, using NUMBER syntax. Loading time is not a visit duration.

hideout.description: Exact Spawning discoverable Hideout form, with a Hideout… identifier made of letters, digits and underscores.

passive.description: Operation allocated/unallocated, skill identifier (letters, digits, underscore and apostrophe) and nonempty name. Parsing does not validate the identifier against an external catalogue.

mastery.description: Numeric effect ID, mastery identifier and nonempty name in the exact Successfully allocated mastery effect id form.

jewel.description: ALTERNATE TREE JEWEL with decimal version, seed and keystone selection. Values are retained without interpreting the tree.

currency.description: Literal CurrencyApplicationForesightResult recieved marker. The original typo is preserved. The marker does not establish the result of currency use.

labyrinth.description: Literal InstanceClientLabyrinthCraftResultOptionsList recieved marker, preserving the original typo.

settlers.description: GoldRespec with integer PassivesAllocated and GoldCost and exact vertical separators. Numbers remain strings.

trade.description: Exact local player brought an item for … gold phrase. It does not determine the direction of item or money transfer.

etrade.description: Service requests and responses: API type, request_id, error and latency in ms. A recognized response does not prove a successful player trade.

stash.description: Two exact phrases for reordering tabs and subtabs to match stash data.

tutorial.description: Exact request to complete tutorials due to a client setting. The parser performs no game operation.

screen.description: Every rule requires the ": " prefix after the client header and a full format match. Character names exclude spaces and colons; names and classes are not validated against a registry. Numeric values remain strings. Point types, item actions, resistance and movement rewards, Kitava penalties and crafting notices accept only the alternatives in their patterns. apply_failed uses the finite APPLY_FAILURES list; use_failed has two explicit reasons. Trade accepted/cancelled and the expired hideout trade warning do not identify items, price or partner. Character messages may refer to others. Death/kill counters, played time and character age are displayed totals, not new events to add together. Duration variants preserve singular/plural forms. Remaining monsters has a separate singular form; comma-separated counts use groups of three digits. AFK ON/OFF is exact; the quoted reply may be empty. Bestiary, Hiveblood, divination card markup and Expedition artifact types accept only observed forms. screen.phrase.* covers the finite SCREEN_PHRASES list and Become the nightmare. The trailing space in "Overpower, overrun, overcome. " is required. No speaker, cause or action is inferred from a phrase. Other notifications are individual exact patterns, not a catch-all for any prefixed text. Optional chest_locked.key_required is null when the Treasure Key phrase is absent; otherwise its original delimiters are retained. Tree-roots notices have an exact three-line continuation sequence; screen phrases match a finite list. Supporter inscriptions are not inferred from a generic screen prefix.

chat.description: Channel messages start with % or #; whispers with @To or @From. An optional guild tag, character name excluding spaces/colons/angle brackets and possibly empty text follow. Markers, direction and text are preserved literally. Text is never executed, and a trade offer does not prove a completed trade. Conversations are displayed on their dedicated local report page. Unprefixed local chat requires a character name previously confirmed by a character notification or marked chat earlier in the same file, including previous log-opening sessions. One optional leading NUL is preserved as a marker; other controls are rejected. Known dialogue signatures retain priority.

dialogue.description: Only the finite SPEAKERS catalogue is accepted. A final CR can introduce a paragraph only when followed immediately by a CR-only separator and one nonempty line without controls or an initial timestamp. Headers and unframed text without the separator are not consumed. A signature alone does not establish the speaker’s role.

action.description: Exact triggered/instant/update/animation/channelling errors, preserving actionwas. ContactAttack requires a Metadata/… path. Continuation fields are listed separately. A runtime action ID is not assumed to be a game skill ID.

geal.description: Object errors contain a hexadecimal object_id, signed integer x/y coordinates, a Metadata/… path and one GEAL_REASONS value. Missing animation events and a Metadata/….ao path with a specific empty-result reason have separate rules.

engine.description: Versions have 2–4 numeric components; revision is an integer. Directories are Settings/Current/Cache/Download; cache names may include underscores. Found/deleted pipeline cache paths accept .foz, .bin, .toc, /TOUCH or /index, NUMBER size and B/KB/MB/GB units. Lifecycle stages are Init, Ready and Reset static. Windows Version/OS text and Build are recorded as client output; they do not contradict the confirmed Ubuntu/Steam origin of the logs.

startup.description: Start and duration of Registration/Game/Device/Tencent/Loading/DebugGUI stages. Duration is NUMBER in seconds.

game.description: Exact Closing game gracefully phrase. Log opening alone does not establish a game session boundary.

setting.description: Only subsystem/setting pairs in BOOLEAN_SETTINGS and ON/OFF state are accepted. A setting from one subsystem cannot be transferred to another. The observed MAT: Ingore Temp typo is preserved; an unverified corrected spelling is not accepted.

job.description: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/IDLE priorities and count; exact Start, Exception Callback: SET and true/false priority boost.

storage.description: Mapping bucket count and exact bundle cache initialization.

runtime.description: Dynamic Bucket count for MESH/MAT/GRAPH with an integer value.

bundle.description: BundlesN/….bin index path, entries/slots/directories counts, NUMBER size and B/KB/MB/GB units.

memory.description: Used, OsUsed and Total with a separate B/KB/MB/GB unit for each NUMBER. Units are not converted.

precalc.description: Only table names in PRECALC_TABLES after Precalc are accepted.

entity2.description: Regather Pass Types or Object Types.

lmdb.description: Environment path and exact Access denied error. After removing LF/CRLF, exactly one additional CR may remain; it is saved as trailing_cr, otherwise an empty string. No global strip is applied. raw_base64 retains the entire original delimiter.

render.description: Device start with null backend, Vulkan or DirectX11; 2–4 component driver versions; GPU scheduling Enabled/Disabled. Exact startup failure, DirectX11 fallback, Blit overflow and enumerated restart stages. A diagnostic line does not prove rendering succeeded.

adapter.description: Adapter name, integer Selected/Max feature levels and a DISPLAY device path with a numeric suffix.

d3d11.description: Buffer count, two-component runtime/feature versions, enumerated YES/NO driver capabilities, Intel/NVidia vendor and fullscreen 0/1.

vulkan.description: Supported/Requesting instance/device VK_… extensions; Fifo/Immediate/Mailbox/FifoRelaxed present modes and a separate hexadecimal invalid value. SwapChain dimensions, Min Image Count, heaps, Graphics/Transfer queues and GPU data are retained. Properties/flags require exact brace and separator syntax; combinations are not interpreted. LUID is hexadecimal and device text nonempty. Lifecycle stages and unsupported transfer queue use the exact finite alternatives. Extensions are validated syntactically without an external registry. The word invalid does not imply a parser error.

shader.description: Cache identifier, PSO Enabled/Disabled and the exact missing ShaderCacheVulkan.packed/index.dat error.

dxc.description: Exact dxcompiler.dll load message; the library name is retained.

streamline.description: Initialization and NUMBER duration; DLSS/Reflex/PCL component and NGX versions (2–4 components); NIS/FSR/XeSS/PSSR proxies. Enabled true/false for the supported components and Reflex Low Latency/Flash Indicator ON/OFF. Shutdown Start/complete and decimal duration without exponent.

window.description: Lost/Gained focus, TriggerDeviceCreate/TriggerDeviceReset/TriggerDeviceDestroyed and NUMBER DPI scale. Focus loss does not prove inactivity.

scene.description: Static Walkability Texture and Height Map Texture with integer dimensions. Set Source contains nonempty bracketed text; (null) and (unknown) are preserved literally.

asset.description: Art/….ast path and bone name with letters, digits, underscores and optional nonempty segments separated by vertical bars; exact has no vertex influences ending.

effect.description: Numeric missing node type ID, or a node name and quoted .fxgraph path.

mat.description: Table size, combination count and parameter count with exact double spaces. Missing table uses a separate literal phrase.

graph.description: Deadlock with timeout in ms and no running graph or running graph nodes: Present/RecordUI state.

pathfinding.description: CalculateShortestPathToRoot and an integer number of examined nodes.

skill.description: Skill identifier in the exact Could not find row for … skill.. form, including both trailing dots.

font.description: Nonempty typeface in Empty font file … Skipping..., with exact parentheses and ellipsis.

clientstring.description: INVALID CLIENTSTRING with a letters/digits/underscores identifier.

network.description: Instance connections use IPv4 octets 0–255 and port 1–65535; one trailing space is allowed. Async hostnames use lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens with nonempty segments. Connected and instance latency contain integer milliseconds. Resyncing is an integer with no assumed unit. Disconnect forms cover unexpected disconnection, realm maintenance and instance connection failure. New types do not automatically extend the selected timeline events. Site-settings SSL failures require the exact cURL/schannel/InitializeSecurityContext chain, a SEC_E_* code, an eight-digit hexadecimal HRESULT and the retry suffix.

http.description: cURL backend; PoE release/tags/N.N.N User-Agent with optional letter suffix and Windows x32/x64. This is client text, not detection of the host OS.

filter.description: Filter IDs, IPv4, HTTP status 100–599, downloads, saving, reloading and lists. Hashes are nonempty lowercase hexadecimal tokens of variable length; no algorithm or fixed length is assumed. (empty) has a separate form and is also allowed for local_hash. Reload includes true/false, Type Normal and possibly empty Message. A recognized HTTP status does not prove download success.

steam.description: Stats stored; Achivement stored preserving the original typo, with an identifier and optional trailing percent sign; stat failure and exact content recheck notice.

patch.description: Exact request to restart Path of Exile after an update.

daily_deal.description: Specific download exception with an HTTP/HTTPS URL and status 100–599. The URL is not opened.

input.description: Selected xinputN_N.dll library in the exact Selected XInput.dll message.

ui.description: Rebuild UI with numeric mode and an exact input method change notice. Virtual keyboard has mode, default text and title separated by single-quoted delimiters. Text may contain apostrophes. Delimiters and final quote are required; ambiguity uses the first ' and title ' separator. Fields may contain user search text and remain in the local analysis.

sound.description: NUMBER buffer size with B/KB/MB/GB unit, actual/requested channel counts and source count; hexadecimal FMOD version and quoted device name.

reliquary.description: A custom chest message requires generation of a RELIQUARY_AREAS ID, a matching scene, entry and completed loading in the same client context. One INFO message is accepted per visit. System rules retain priority, except thrill_void and conqueror in this context. Consecutive unframed text lines belong to the same message until a new header, blank or invalid line. Area changes, log opening, disconnects, invalid records, client changes or tick regression reset the context. Item identity and pickup are not inferred. A temporary (null) scene is allowed before entry. Closing the game or connecting to another instance also resets the context.
